Rules :
1. Open Talent
Participants can showcase any talent, including singing, dance, comedy,
mimicry, magic, poetry, acting, beatboxing, instrumental music, storytelling,
and more.
2. Solo Participation VVIT GOT LATENT is a solo competition. Each participant
will perform individually.
3. Performance Time Maximum 150 seconds (2 minutes 30 seconds).
4. Special Extension If the organizers/panel feel that a performance is
exceptionally engaging and worth continuing, they may grant an additional 60
seconds at their discretion. Any extension is entirely subject to the organizers'
approval.
5. Funny G-Form Participants will be required to answer a set of funny,
unexpected, quirky, and creative questions in the registration Google Form.
6. On-Stage Questions
The panel may ask participants questions based on their responses in the
Funny G-Form during the event.
7. Languages English, Hindi, Kannada, or a combination of these languages.
8. Live Performance
The talent must be performed live on stage. Fully pre-recorded performances
are not allowed.
9.Props may be used, subject to approval by the event coordinators.
10. Content All performances, G-Form responses, and on-stage interactions
must remain appropriate for a college event. Vulgar, sexually explicit, abusive,
discriminatory, offensive, or inappropriate content is strictly prohibited.
11. Judging Participants will be evaluated based on Talent/Skill, Creativity,
Originality, Stage Presence, Humour/Wit, Entertainment Value, Panel
Interaction, and Overall Performance.
12. Winners The Top 3 performers with the highest scores will be declared 1st,
2nd, and 3rd place, respectively.
13. Final Decision The decision of the judges regarding the scores and final
results will be final and binding

TECHNINJA– QUIZ
Description
Acompetitive team-based quiz designed to test participants'technical knowledge,
logicalthinking, speed, and accuracy through challenging multiple-choice
questions.
Rules
1.Each team must consist of exactly two members. Solo participation is not
allowed.
2.Each question will have four options, and only one answer must be selected.
3.Each team must bring one smartphone to participate in the quiz.
4.The use ofAItools, search engines, or any external assistance is strictly
prohibited.
5.Any team found cheating or using unauthorized assistance will be immediately
disqualified.
6.Only the top 10 teams based on scores will qualify forthe next stage.
7.Only the top 5 teams from the qualifying stage will advance to the Final Round.
Notes
1.The total duration ofthe quiz will be approximately 1.5–2 hours.
2.Participants mustreportto the venue atleast15 minutes before the event
begins.
3.Latecomers may be disqualified atthe discretion ofthe organizers.
4.Participants must maintain proper discipline and decorum throughoutthe
event.
5.Any team causing disruptions during the event may be disqualified.
6.Ifthe total number ofregistered teams is fewerthan 6,the event will be
cancelled.
7.The Judge's decision will be final and binding in all matters related to the
competition.

Air Crash - Survival
Eligibility: Open to allregularly enrolled Undergraduate (UG) students from our campus,
as well as Undergraduate (UG) students from all outside colleges and institutions.
Avalid college ID card is mandatory.
• Home Preparation: Students must get prepared oftheir chosen personas from their
home itself before attending the event.No on-the-spotrandom chits will be given.
•Authentic Real Personas Only: Every participant must choose a real person from world
history orthe contemporary era (e.g., scientists, world leaders, industrialists,
philosophers, humanitarians, athletes).
Fictional characters (superheroes, anime figures, cinematic creations) and mythological
entities are strictly prohibited.
• Mandatory Pre-Registration (First-Come, First-Served): Participants mustregister
their chosen persona via the official Google Form priorto the event.
No duplicate personas will be permitted. Iftwo participants selectthe same figure,the
participant with the earlier submission timestamp is assigned the persona;the second
participant will be notified to pick an alternate.
• Language of Delivery: The official language ofthe eventis English.All speeches,
rebuttals, and jury interactions must be conducted in English.
• Decorum & Stage Conduct: Constructive critique of a historicalfigure's decisions,
policies, and philosophy is actively encouraged. However, personal insults, derogatory
slurs, or unparliamentary language directed atfellow student advocates willresultin
immediate disqualification.
• Props & Presentation Materials: Subtle costumes, badges, or symbolic handheld props
matching the persona are permitted. Reading directly from mobile phones or prepared
papers on stage is strictly disallowed.

Rules
1. Team & Eligibility
Open only to undergraduate students.
Each team must consist of 2–3 members.
Registration fee: ₹50 per team.
2. Theme & Content
Themes will be assigned on the spot.
No prior preparation or pre-planned content related to the assigned theme is allowed.
Reel muste educational and entertaining, with a maximum duration of 90 seconds.
3. AI & Originality
AI tools are strictly prohibited for creating, generating, editing, modifying, or
enhancing the reel.
The reel must be completely created and edited by the participating team.
4. Submission
Teams must create, record, edit, and submit the reel between 9:30 AM and 3:00 PM.
Final videos must be emailed to the student coordinators.
Late submissions may not be accepted.
5. Conduct & Evaluation
Vulgar, obscene, offensive, adult, or inappropriate content is strictly prohibited.
Reels will be evaluated based on creativity, originality, educational/entertainment
value, teamwork, and theme adherence.
The decision of the event coordinators regarding content acceptance, participation,
disqualification, and prize distribution will be final

PIXELS is an on-campus photography competition organized underInnovate and
Ignite 2026 at Vijaya Vittala Institute of Technology. The event encourages
participants to capture visual stories and see the world through a differentlens.
Event Details:
• Date: October 9, 2026
• Time: 9:30AM onwards
• Venue: Quadrangle
• Registration Fee: ₹50 per participant
Rules & Guidelines:
1.Open to allregistered students using smartphones or standard cameras
(DSLR/Mirrorless).
2.All photographs must be shot on campus during the event hours.
3.Only basic editing (brightness, contrast, cropping, color correction)is permitted.
Image manipulation,AI generation, or heavy compositing is strictly prohibited.
4.Entries must be original photographs taken during the competition and
submitted in JPEG/PNG format before the announced deadline.
5.The judges decision will be final, and participants cannot dispute or challenge the
result.
6.Each participant mustregister and participate individually. Team entries are not
allowed.
